items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: And then... Tom played nice trombone with them, too.

ctx.x: They left nothing to be hoped for, I'll tell you. They had plenty of rhythm, tight combo. But I'll tell you, another band had a wonderful combo. I can't understand how he felt like he did, Johnny Posdorff. Mm-hmm. Oh, when Johnny was at the Tokyo Garden with Pete Skaglione and them guys, they had a group out of this world. They already played with him out there. Mm-hmm. They had a group out of this world, eh, for dance music. They really played some nice stuff. And then... Tom played nice trombone with them, too.
Who? Tom Brown. Yeah, Tom was with him.

And then I was surprised, man, when Johnny come back, Raymond come to my house one night, he says, come on out on the highway, we're playing on the highway, I want you to hear something. And I went out there. I couldn't believe it was the same guy. I don't know what happened. He went to Chicago and... He just... He got Willie. His lip just won't let him do it, man. She's I did. He had the lip.
